eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 38 · Grouping and Aggregating

code:
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Person.Person
  WHERE LastName LIKE 'A%'
UNION
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Person.Person
  WHERE LastName LIKE 'Z%';
caption: JOIN combines side by side (more columns). UNION stacks top to bottom (more rows).

code:
-- UNION: compares every row against every
-- other row to find duplicates — real work
-- UNION ALL: skips that entirely
caption: Default to UNION ALL unless you specifically need duplicates removed.

subtitle: Measuring how spread out your data is.
